data.body: Operator context (2026-08-14), recorded so this work is interpreted correctly: the verifier was originally a simple harness-native read-only subagent and was reliable; runaway tool calls / context overruns appeared only after the harness-independent transition, and the banking/budget/recovery machinery is containment for those emergent failure modes. This ticket (generous budgets + child-traversal term + PASS-verdict cache) is INTERIM SYMPTOM RELIEF and proceeds as planned — but it is not a direction to extend. The long-term direction is viral-peppy-lowchen (b4be-0ed8-22cb-4b01): deterministic evidence prepack + single-pass verdict, demoting banking/budget to a rarely-exercised runaway backstop. Any further verifier complexity must justify itself against that simple-core goal.
